entities.summary: Aeroflot Flight 909 was a scheduled domestic flight overnight on 5–6 March 1976 flown by Ilyushin Il-18E registered CCCP-74508. The aircraft lost control following an electrical failure and crashed near Voronezh in the Soviet Union. All 111 on board were killed, including 7 on the ground, making it the deadliest plane crash in Russia.
